title: Like Before but Blue
tests: Uses the prior poster as the edit reference and changes only its background colour, preserving text, layout and artwork.

faults.what: The output is square rather than the requested 4:5 portrait poster.

judge.summary: The poster has the correct navy background, cream text and crescent, but its square format fails the requested 4:5 aspect ratio.

must_haves.item: The final output is one 4:5 poster with a deep navy background instead of burnt orange.
must_haves.why: One deep navy poster is visible, but it is square rather than 4:5.
The headline clearly reads NIGHT MARKET across two lines.

must_haves.item: The smaller line reads exactly 'SATURDAY 6–10 PM'.
must_haves.why: The smaller cream line reads SATURDAY 6–10 PM.

must_haves.item: The cream lettering and cream crescent moon retain their previous positions, sizes and appearance.
must_haves.why: The cream lettering and crescent are visible, but no previous poster is provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: No new words, decorative elements or layout changes are introduced.
must_haves.why: There are no extra words or decorative elements visible beyond the requested crescent, but layout changes cannot be assessed without the previous poster.
